definition: An unsupervised technique for discovering the abstract 'topics' that occur within a collection of documents.
details: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) is a classic topic modeling algorithm; topic modeling is used for exploratory data analysis, content organization, and understanding themes across large text corpora.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Topic Modeling.
